meta.name: Yugoslavia and Greece
meta.note: Approximate reconstruction. Germany, Italy, Hungary and Bulgaria all take part; all of them are drawn as one Axis. Crete at the end is an airborne assault, not an advancing line.

keyframes.label: Germany invades Yugoslavia and Greece. Belgrade is bombed without a declaration of war.
Zagreb falls and Croatia declares independence. Yugoslavia comes apart from inside.
Greece surrenders in the north. The Metaxas Line is outflanked through Yugoslavia.
German troops enter Athens. The swastika goes up on the Acropolis.
The Peloponnese is overrun. The British evacuate to Crete and Egypt.
Crete falls to an airborne assault. It is the last German paratroop operation of the war: the losses are so heavy Hitler never tries it again.
